item.text: {"groups":[{"member_ids":["bbe7d5ba92e48236c7b7","cebe418407d61d7bc125"],"operation":"Allocate the document URL base during XInclude processing.","condition":"That specific allocation fails.","capability":"Record XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY in ctxt->errNo so xmlXIncludeGetLastError exposes it.","consequence":"The existing XInclude error-code check may fail.","equivalence_reason":"Both describe the same base-allocation failure and the same context error-code requirement."},{"member_ids":["2c6e807e71c4da91c2e9","d0aa3ea19161e54c1c4f"],"operation":"Report an XInclude processing memory error.","condition":"An XInclude allocation fails after processing is reached.","capability":"Record XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY in ctxt->errNo for xmlXIncludeGetLastError.","consequence":"The existing allocation-failure assertion may abort.","equivalence_reason":"Both describe the general XInclude memory-error reporting requirement; neither is limited to the document URL base allocation."},{"member_ids":["9c166ecbbb0585e1bf18","5fb52fe87fb7687769f0","9620928f1ba7a2f401fa","12a55f9011f9353af572"],"operation":"Deliver an XInclude error through a handler registered on the XInclude context.","condition":"A context structured handler is configured and an XInclude error occurs.","capability":"Store the handler and user data with the context setter and pass them through xmlXIncludeErr to __xmlRaiseError.","consequence":"The configured handler may not receive the error and its user data.","equivalence_reason":"All four describe delivery through the new context-specific structured error handler."},{"member_ids":["1b930d756a9098b83e89","15ab20481890548a6be4","e07f4c8498e14d0bb961"],"operation":"Process a local XPointer inclusion in XInclude streaming mode.","condition":"Streaming mode is enabled and the inclusion uses a local XPointer.","capability":"Reject the expression with XML_XINCLUDE_XPTR_FAILED.","consequence":"The streaming-mode restriction may not be exercised or observed.","equivalence_reason":"All three describe the same streaming XPointer condition and rejection behavior."},{"member_ids":["cb7452a02aad111915a4","2f6e8fa8a357f4e4eff0"],"operation":"Call xmlXIncludeProcessNode with a parsed document node containing an include.","condition":"The call encounters the node->doc guard.","capability":"Reach DOM XInclude processing for that document node.","consequence":"The DOM XInclude operation may stop before processing the include.","equivalence_reason":"Both describe reachability of the same document-node call through the same guard."}]}
